data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has experienced a positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k in the year, predominately in respect of Accident and Health business (2016: GBP 3,031k, predominately in respect of Property and Accident and Health businesses).

named_events.loss_description: Storms in the South-eastern USA and Caribbean in September 2017, compounded by two earthquakes in Mexico; the syndicate had exposure in the property, marine and contingency classes.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 gross claims outstanding were GBP 77.173m. During 2017 the Syndicate recorded a positive prior-year run-off (a release) of GBP 3.714m, driven predominantly by favourable claims development in Accident & Health (with prior-year favourable experience also in Property and Accident & Health in 2016). The 2017 result was nonetheless impacted by major current-year catastrophe activity (the 'HIMM' storms and earthquakes) that affected Property and Marine exposures.
raw_causal_phrases: positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k in the year, predominately in respect of Accident and Health business
storms in the South-eastern USA and Caribbean in September 2017
two earthquakes occurring in Mexico, collectively referred to as the "HIMM" losses
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (GBP 3,714k release) taken from the narrative 'positive run off deviation' sentence. The report's movement / triangle tables are present but the formal 'Movement in prior year's provision' gross column was not explicitly labelled separately as a single gross PYD figure in the movement table; therefore the narrative amount was used. No explicit per-LOB monetary split of the PYD was provided. A gross claims development triangle is present but was not fully parsed numerically for all cells in this extraction.
